veranderings.blok: Ver weg, en tog die naaste ster
veranderings.voor: Dit is die rede waarom hy vir ons
veranderings.na: Dit is hoekom hy vir ons
veranderings.rede: 'Dit is die rede waarom' is a stiff calque of 'that is the reason why'; 'Dit is hoekom' is shorter and more natural for Grade 4.

veranderings.na: 'n gewone sonbril gee nie sulke beskerming nie
veranderings.rede: 'bied dit nie' is formal and the pronoun is loose; naming the protection makes the safety point unmistakable without changing its scope.

vlae.teks: wat heeltemal uit baie warm gas bestaan
vlae.rede: 'baie warm gas' can be read as 'a lot of warm gas' rather than 'very hot gas'; left unchanged because the fix risks altering register or meaning, noted for the reviewer.
